This pattern is directly visible in the diff and is a real upgrade-blocking defect.

adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` unconditionally does `execute(...)[0]['id']` when looking up the old `embed_category` (and similarly `execute(...)[0]['value']` for `uncategorized_category_id`). If those queries return 0 rows (e.g., `embed_category` was never set, or the join `s.value = c.name` finds no match), `[0]` is `nil` and `nil['id']`/`nil['value']` will raise `NoMethodError`, blocking upgrades. The join also depends on the stored value exactly matching a category name, which can fail.
